ONE TABLE ACROSS TWO PAGES: fifteen debt issues against THIRTY fiscal years, FY2018-FY2028 on page 41 and FY2029-FY2047 on page 42, each issue in three printed rows -- PRINCIPAL, INTEREST and the issue's own TOTAL -- and the two pages carry the identical fifteen issue labels in the identical order. THE PRINTED HEADER, VERBATIM: the left column is headed `FISCAL YEAR`; the money columns are headed only by the year, `2018` to `2028` on page 41 and `2029` to `2047` on page 42. There is no TOTAL column and no per-issue total: this schedule prints its arithmetic DOWN the page, in three rows at the foot of every year column -- `GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL`, `GRAND TOTAL INTEREST` and `TOTAL DEBT`. A footnote runs under both pages: `*MASS WATER POLLUTION ABATEMENT TRUST: PAYMENT AMOUNTS TO BE SUBSIDIZED BY EQUITY EARNINGS AND CONTRACT ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS`. HOW IT WAS READ: each page is a SINGLE EMBEDDED SCAN -- pdfplumber returns one word (the folio) and one image -- so the scanner's own pixels were taken straight off the PDF with pypdf, rotated upright and cropped into column blocks with the label strip pasted beside each block, which is how a figure is kept attached to the row it is printed on. No render scale adds detail a scan does not hold, and neither render script was used, so neither could clip the page. THE GRAIN IS ONE FILE PER FISCAL YEAR, which is what makes this page checkable: the schedule's own arithmetic runs down each year column, so a year is the unit the document proves. Each file holds that year's fifteen issues against the three GRAND TOTAL rows the page prints beneath them. Thirty files, THIRTY INDEPENDENT YEARS, ninety column assertions. WHAT PROVES IT, three ways on every year. (1) THE COLUMN: the fifteen issues' PRINCIPAL adds to the printed `GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL`, their INTEREST to `GRAND TOTAL INTEREST`, and their issue TOTALS to `TOTAL DEBT`. (2) THE ROW: principal + interest = the issue's own printed TOTAL, on every issue-year the page prints a total for -- 198 of them. (3) The page's two grand totals add to its own `TOTAL DEBT`. ALL NINETY COLUMN ASSERTIONS AND ALL 198 ROW IDENTITIES CLOSE WITHIN ONE DOLLAR, and most close exactly: 2018 principal ties to the dollar at $2,985,086 across fifteen addends and 2029 principal at $1,413,855 across eight. THE DECLARED TOLERANCE IS $1.00 AND IT IS DERIVED, NOT FITTED. The schedule displays WHOLE DOLLARS over amounts that carry cents -- the MWPAT loans and the sewer and water issues all do -- so a printed total is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts. The widest column on either page has FIFTEEN addends (FY2018), so the arithmetic bound on a column is 15 x $0.50 plus the printed total's own $0.50, i.e. $8. THE OBSERVED MAXIMUM ACROSS ALL 90 COLUMN ASSERTIONS AND ALL 198 ROW IDENTITIES IS $1. The tolerance is set at the observed maximum and sits seven times inside the arithmetic bound. It is NOT a safe guard against a misread of the UNITS digit, because these are whole-dollar displays and such a misread also costs $1; what bounds that risk is that every principal and every interest figure is asserted TWICE, once against its issue's own TOTAL row and once against that year's GRAND TOTAL row, and 288 assertions over 30 independent years would not all land inside $1 if the reading were loose. ONE THING THE DOCUMENT GETS WRONG AND IT IS ATTESTED, NOT TOLERATED: in FY2024 the page prints $418,704 of PRINCIPAL against `MASS WATER POOL 9*` and prints NOTHING on that issue's INTEREST row and NOTHING on its `TOTAL MASS WATER POLL TRUST` row. The $418,704 IS in the printed `GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL` for 2024 -- the fifteen principals tie to $1,973,186 EXACTLY -- and `TOTAL DEBT` for 2024 equals `GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL` plus `GRAND TOTAL INTEREST` exactly, so the omission is only in the per-issue TOTAL column, which is therefore $418,704 short of the TOTAL DEBT it foots to. That is the document disagreeing with itself and it is recorded as `attested` on the FY2024 total column. WHICH FIGURE IS WRONG IS NOT ESTABLISHED and nothing on the page says. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH. The page names its issues and nothing more: an issue name is not a project, and `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` appears TWICE and `MS-HS CONSTRUCTION` TWICE with nothing printed to tell the two apart -- the `#nn` in `fund_number` is OUR ordinal, the issue's printed position down the page, and is not a number the town prints. Nor does the schedule say what the town will actually pay: the footnote states that the MWPAT amounts are to be SUBSIDIZED by equity earnings and contract assistance payments, and the amount of that subsidy is printed nowhere here. This is a FORWARD schedule of scheduled debt service as of 30 June 2017 and is a BUDGET quantity throughout; it is not an actual, and CLAUDE.md rule 1 forbids differencing it against one.
